# ƒмитрий  оролЄв Ч ќпыты в стихах и прозе

> Personal website of Dmitry Korolev (ƒмитрий  оролЄв; Ukrainian official name: Dmytro Korolov), an author writing in Russian, born 1973 in Ukraine. The site collects original poetry, prose, essays, and humor published online since the early 2000s.

## About the Author

ƒмитрий ¬ладимирович  оролЄв (Dmytro Korolov) Ч author writing in Russian, originally from Ukraine, currently living in Seychelles. Born 1973. He is not affiliated with any literary union or official institution. His work spans poetry, short prose, philosophical dialogue, travel essay, and humor. He has been publishing online since the early 2000s, and the site korolev.kiev.ua has been the primary home of his writing since then.

Name variants: ƒмитрий  оролЄв, ƒмитрий ¬ладимирович  оролЄв, Dmitry Korolev, Dmytro Korolov, Korolyov.

Contact: dmitry@korolev.kiev.ua

## Notable Works

- **Ѕеседы с ∆оржем** (Conversations with George) Ч a 44-chapter series of philosophical and literary dialogues between the author and his interlocutor George. Available as a free e-book (epub, fb2).
- **¬тора€ книга** (Second Book) Ч a collection of prose and poetry. Available as a free e-book (epub, fb2).
- Poetry collections spanning 2002Ц2026, organized by year.
- Travel essays including pieces on Istanbul, Mauritius, Seychelles.
- A long-running series of humorous short pieces.

## Language and Style

All works are written in Russian. The poetry ranges from classical forms to free verse. The prose includes philosophical dialogues, satirical sketches, travel writing, and realist short fiction. The humor section features parodies and absurdist pieces.
